decisions.reason: Removing requirements to confirm specific design-token colors and button states does not remove the landing page's approved visual theme, headline font, green button accent, or other visual choices.
The responsive-layout and breakpoint requirements do not depend on the removed color-confirmation or button-state attributes.
The implementation stack and handoff objective remain valid independently of the removed design-token confirmation details.

The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY that removes the obsolete detailed styling guidance, including the color and button-state guidance, and replaces it with the simplified informational-page treatment.
The sign-in page's Actia branding, landing-page-derived background, header logo, and optional footer remain valid without confirmed token values or button-state specifications.
The footer content, links, social icons, copyright, and page usage do not depend on the removed design-token confirmation attributes.
Removing specific website token-confirmation requirements does not cancel the independent requirement to provide console-shell styling guidance for fonts, colors, icons, and theme modes.
The shared dark visual basis and simplified informational-page treatment remain valid without the removed exact color-confirmation and button-state requirements.
The no-header-navigation requirement is independent of confirmed design-token colors and button interaction states.
